# TRUVARI_BENCH

Benchmark structural variant calls against a truth VCF inside a supplied BED interval. The process keeps INS, DEL, and DUP calls, then runs Truvari with `--passonly --pctseq 0 --dup-to-ins`.

Input: `sample` record with `id` (String), `vcf` (Path to sorted, bgzipped call VCF), `tbi` (Path to its Tabix index), `bed` (Path to evaluation BED), `truth_vcf` (Path to bgzipped truth VCF), and `truth_tbi` (Path to its Tabix index). All files must use the same reference coordinates. Use an ID suitable for a filename.

Output: record with the same `id`, `summary` JSON, `log` text, and full `report_dir` from Truvari.

nextflow.enable.types = true

record BenchmarkInput {
    id: String
    vcf: Path
    tbi: Path
    bed: Path
    truth_vcf: Path
    truth_tbi: Path
}

process TRUVARI_BENCH {
    container 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/truvari_bcftools_htslib:3c6b66ee42c03988'

    input:
    sample: BenchmarkInput

    output:
    record(
        id: sample.id,
        summary: file("${sample.id}.truvari.summary.json"),
        log: file("${sample.id}.truvari.log.txt"),
        report_dir: file("${sample.id}.truvari"),
    )

    script:
    """
    bcftools view -i 'SVTYPE="INS" || SVTYPE="DEL" || SVTYPE="DUP"' \
        -O z -o ${sample.id}.benchmark.vcf.gz ${sample.vcf}
    tabix -p vcf ${sample.id}.benchmark.vcf.gz
    truvari bench \
        --passonly --pctseq 0 --dup-to-ins \
        -b ${sample.truth_vcf} \
        -c ${sample.id}.benchmark.vcf.gz \
        -o ${sample.id}.truvari \
        --includebed ${sample.bed}
    cp ${sample.id}.truvari/summary.json ${sample.id}.truvari.summary.json
    cp ${sample.id}.truvari/log.txt ${sample.id}.truvari.log.txt
    """
}

$schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextflow-io/schemas/refs/heads/main/module/v1/schema.json
name: seqera-services/truvari_bench
version: 0.1.0
kind: Process
description: Compare filtered SV calls against an indexed truth VCF.
keywords:
- structural variants
- benchmark
- precision and recall
license: MIT
authors:
- Seqera Services
tools:
- truvari:
    description: Structural variant comparison and benchmark statistics.
    documentation: https://github.com/ACEnglish/truvari
- bcftools:
    description: Select INS, DEL, and DUP calls for comparison.
    documentation: https://samtools.github.io/bcftools/bcftools.html
- tabix:
    description: Index the selected calls.
    documentation: https://www.htslib.org/doc/tabix.html
input:
- name: sample
  type: record
  description: Record with id (String), vcf, tbi, bed, truth_vcf, and truth_tbi (Paths).
output:
- - name: id
    type: string
    description: Input ID.
  - name: summary
    type: file
    description: Truvari summary JSON.
  - name: log
    type: file
    description: Truvari log text.
  - name: report_dir
    type: directory
    description: Full Truvari benchmark output directory.
